name: FindSaunaPlunge
description: Cold plunge, sauna and contrast-therapy studios across US metros. Every venue record carries the date it was last checked; every published price and temperature carries its source URL, capture date and quote. Absent fields mean the studio does not publish that detail, never zero.
author: FindSaunaPlunge

tools.name: search_venues
tools.title: Search venues
tools.description: Search cold plunge / sauna venues. All filters are optional and AND-combined. Absent fields in results mean "not published", never zero.

citySlug.description: City slug, e.g. "dallas-tx". Use list_cities to discover.

access.description: private_suite = your own room; communal = shared areas; mixed matches either request. Venues that do not publish their access model are excluded whenever this filter is used — absence of the fact is not a match.

maxDropInUsd.description: Only venues with a PUBLISHED drop-in price at or below this. Excludes venues with no published price.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.title: Get one venue
tools.description: Fetch the full record for one venue by its stable id.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.title: List covered cities
tools.description: Cities with live venues, with counts and available modalities.

tools.name: get_city_stats
tools.title: Get city statistics
tools.description: Aggregate figures for one covered city: venue count, modality and access breakdowns, contrast-capable count, and median published prices and plunge temperature. Every median carries its denominator (n) — absent fields are excluded, never treated as zero.

citySlug.description: City slug, e.g. "dallas-tx". Use list_cities to discover.

tools.name: get_data_freshness
tools.title: Get dataset freshness
tools.description: When the dataset was generated and how recently venues were checked: oldest and newest lastVerified dates, counts by age bucket, and the newest check date per city.
